newsitem.title: UK: No UK rate move needed at present - CBI's Buckland.
newsitem.headline: No UK rate move needed at present - CBI's Buckland.

text.p: There is no need for a move in UK interest rates at the moment, Ross Buckland, a member of the Confederation of British Industry economic affairs committee, said on Tuesday.

"This was discussed at some length within the (CBI) economic affairs committee...and the conclusions were that whilst it was finely balanced, no action was necessary at this time," Buckland told Reuters Financial Television.
He was speaking after the release of the CBI's latest quarterly industrial trends survey.
The survey found that demand for British manufactured exports had levelled off for the first time since October 1993.
The CBI said the recovery in UK output was expected to continue in the next four months, but the impact of sterling's strength was starting to feed through into manufacturers' export orders.
